validity_notes: VN-01: binding-only; no HTTP server, no task traffic; one HuggingFace model download (revision identity recorded in env).
VN-02: mechanism-identity correctness ignores parameter binding (out of scope).
VN-03: bootstrap covers resampling variability only (family-blocked, 5 blocks); a single model and a single bank.

VN-04: contamination screen uses token-set Jaccard (>=0.60) OR char-trigram Jaccard (>=0.75) against goal_generator surfaces plus the parent 140-goal bank; the trigram representation differs from every arm mechanism.
VN-05: ECE descriptive only, not gated.

VN-06: B-LEX-STRONG-LEARNED is a sensitivity bound, not the claim-bearing comparator; its low 15/113 is expected because test-split operation phrasings are disjoint from calibration phrasings and is not evidence about B-LEX-STRONG.

VN-07: residual authorship limitation: the fresh-context authors had no file/tool access and their prompts contained no intent strings (V4 checks the prompt block for exact-intent leaks and near-prior-surface proximity), but latent pretrained knowledge cannot be cryptographically excluded (see prereg V4).

VN-08: checkpoint identity: the frozen revision c9745ed1d9f207416be6d2e6f8de32d1f161f9bf was requested but not available at EXECUTE; the runner used the unpinned fallback, resolved checkpoint 1110a243fdf4706b3f48f1d95db1a4f5529b4d41 (same as the parent packet). Results are interpretable only for the actually-resolved checkpoint (continuity with parent UNRES-04).

VN-09: in derived/predictions.json a resolver abstention is stored as the empty string '' (not null) for stronglex/learned/lexical mechanism ids; the abstention count is also explicit in M-MECH-ACC-STRONGLEX.abstentions. An abstention scores as incorrect in all accuracy metrics.

VN-10: sentence-transformers emitted 'No sentence-transformers model found with name sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2. Creating a new one with mean pooling.' on stderr. The treatment remained live and non-degenerate (20 distinct valid mechanism selections; embedding self-match 20/20), so this is a load-path notice, not a dead treatment; it is preserved verbatim in raw_evidence/runner_stderr.txt for AUDIT to assess.

VN-11: the outcome FALSIFIES is a valid scientific negative, not an infrastructure failure. The frozen runner exited 0 and all V1-V12 gates PASS. The embedding treatment executed and varied; it simply scored below the strong deterministic comparator.

VN-12: 'FALSIFIES' here is the preregistered D-RESOLVER branch label (upper_ci <= 0) and is scoped to the embedding-necessity sub-claim on this single frozen 113-goal primary set, this 20-mechanism/5-family fixture and the resolved all-MiniLM-L6-v2 checkpoint; it is not a global falsification of C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE (per packet and parent handoff distinctions).

VN-13: D-GATE is reported independently and is GATE-NOT-MET for both the two-feature logistic gate and the single-feature global-threshold gate. Per the frozen decoupling it does NOT downgrade D-RESOLVER and does not make the packet MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

VN-14: the B-LEX-STRONG comparator lexicon was authored bank-blind per the prereg V4 provenance, but its fixed synonym breadth is a curation choice; the secondary learned arm does not cleanly bound that choice on this split because its train and test phrasings are disjoint (see unresolved).

Whether the stronglex advantage generalizes beyond this 20-mechanism fixture, the 5 resource families, this single 160-goal bank and the resolved all-MiniLM-L6-v2 checkpoint; the family-blocked bootstrap has only 5 resampling blocks (VN-08).
Whether the frozen intent embeddings (the checkpoint c9745ed... was unavailable; resolved 1110a24...) would have produced a materially different A-EMBED-COSINE accuracy than the 78/113 measured here.

Whether B-LEX-STRONG's 97/113 is sensitive to the breadth/wording of its fixed synonym dictionary. The secondary learned arm cannot answer this on this split because test-split operation phrasings are disjoint from calibration ones (M-MECH-ACC-LEARNED=15/113).

Whether any applicability gate with a different score/feature geometry can ever meet test pooled_false_accept <= 0.10, unknown_precision >= 0.85 and coverage >= 0.50; both frozen gates were GATE-NOT-MET with coverage collapsing to 0 at t*=1.0.

Whether the stderr mean-pooling fallback changed embedding semantics relative to a normal sentence-transformers module load; the liveness/self-match evidence bounds this but does not settle it (VN-10).
